subject: BlueRidge: Request for BCP/DR RTO-RPO evidence and recovery artifacts
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@blueridge.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@blueridge.com
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: BCP/DR evidence — RTO/RPO metrics + test artifacts

Hi Neha,

BlueRidge's InfoSec team is running a quarterly evidence collection for critical vendors. We need the following items to complete the BCP/DR section of our SIG:

- RTO and RPO objectives you publish for the Redwood platform (hosted API + dedicated pools + private deployments)
- Most recent full disaster recovery test report (date, scope, results)
- Post-test artifacts: restore logs, time-to-recover measurements, incident timeline (if any)
- Current DR runbook (PDF) and the name/version of the runbook used during testing
- Backup / snapshot retention policy and proof of retention for last 90 days
- Confirmation of encryption-at-rest and key rotation cadence for backups (KMS/HSM notes acceptable)
- Any SOC 2 / third-party attestations that include BCP/DR controls (redacted OK)

Please provide the items or links to secure storage by COB Monday Nov 10 (BlueRidge scheduling constraints). If you have preliminary notes earlier we can begin our review and follow up with questions.

Thanks,
Samantha Liu
Vendor Risk Manager — BlueRidge Financial
Samantha.Liu@blueridge.com

---
Note: If parts of these artifacts require an NDA or dedicated access, let me know and we can arrange a short-term sharing window.

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@blueridge.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 3 Nov 2025 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: BCP/DR evidence — RTO/RPO metrics + test artifacts

Hi Samantha — thanks for the clear list. We're happy to share. High-level summary up front:

- Published objectives: Hosted API (customer-facing service): Recovery Time Objective (RTO): 4 hours for control-plane restoration; Production inference path designed to failover to warm replicas with median tail recovery ~15–30 minutes depending on region and model cache state. Recovery Point Objective (RPO): targeted <15 minutes for user-facing stateful components (streaming replication/backups).
- Dedicated pools: RTO typically within 2–4 hours for control-plane failover; customer data retention and snapshot policies are configurable per contract — default retention is 90 days.
- Private deployments: RTO/RPO are customer-configurable and documented in the runbook we share for each deployment.

I've attached a packet with the most recent DR test artifacts and the runbook excerpt you requested. Quick notes: the last full platform DR test was run on 2025-09-12 (scope: control plane + core inference clusters in us-west-2; outcome: successful restore; measured system-level RTO 2h35m). RPO measurements are in the attached CSV.

Attachments included: redwood_dr_runbook_v2.1.pdf; 20250912_dr_test_results.xlsx; rto_rpo_metrics_summary.csv; backup_retention_policy.pdf; soc2_type2_2025_redacted.pdf

If you need any encrypted transfer or a temporary S3 presigned link, tell me which files you want access to and I'll generate links.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Security & Compliance (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198

Team — forwarding BlueRidge's evidence request. I pulled the attachments in draft but need canonical copies and technical validation before we send. Please produce the following by EOD Thu Nov 6: 

1) Aditya: run the restore verification for the 2025-09-12 DR snapshot set and produce the full restore logs (timestamps in UTC) + a short notes doc that maps measured steps to the runbook sections. Please include any deviations.

2) Rishi: extract the RTO/RPO measurement spreadsheet (per-region, p50/p95/p99 where available) and confirm the RTO timeline used to compute the 2h35m number. Include service-level breakdown (control plane vs inference service vs cache warm-up).

3) Both: confirm backup KMS key rotation date and where key material is stored (HSM/KMS) so I can redact if needed.

I'll assemble a single evidence packet and redacted SOC2 artifact. If anything needs legal review flag it now. BlueRidge wants by COB Nov 10; let's aim to send earlier.

Thanks — Neha

Hi Samantha — attaching the requested artifacts and a short summary so your team can quickly ingest without digging through raw logs. Let me know if you'd like a 30-minute walkthrough.

Summary (high level):
- Last full DR test: 2025-09-12 (scope: control plane, datastore restore, and inference cluster rebuild in us-west-2).
  - Measured system-level recovery time (end-to-end): 2 hours 35 minutes. This includes cluster bootstrap, model cache warm-up, and routing table reconciliation.
  - RPO observed: <15 minutes for customer-facing state via streaming replication and prioritized checkpointing.
- Retention: Default snapshots retained for 90 days; critical audit logs retained for 365 days.
- Keys: Backups encrypted with AWS KMS; key rotation occurs quarterly.
- Test cadence: Quarterly tabletop + semi-annual full restore drills.

Attachments (attached to this email):
- redwood_dr_runbook_v2.1.pdf (runbook excerpt, sensitive sections redacted)
- 20250912_dr_test_results.xlsx (detailed test timeline + pass/fail matrix)
- rto_rpo_metrics_summary.csv (per-region p50/p95/p99)
- backup_retention_policy.pdf (policy excerpt)
- soc2_type2_2025_redacted.pdf (attestation, redacted)

Secure links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwoodDR (preserved with short-term access)
SOC2 doc: https://docs.redwood.com/soc2/2025/redacted

If BlueRidge needs the full un-redacted SOC2 or additional cryptographic proofs (KMS logs), we will require an executed NDA and a short-term access window; happy to coordinate with your legal team.

Please confirm receipt and whether you'd like the compressed evidence bundle or individual files.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
